objectives.description: Convert manage-topics.sh (add, set), reconcile-artifacts.sh, and archive-task.sh's del() removal to state-write.sh calls

deviations.description: manage-topics.sh, reconcile-artifacts.sh, and archive-task.sh previously had no session_id parameter/plumbing at all, and manage-topics.sh has dozens of pre-existing callers across core/cslib/literature extensions
deviations.reason: Added an optional --session-id flag to each converted script, self-generating a session_id via the same portable pattern command-gate-in.sh uses when the flag is omitted, rather than requiring every existing caller (dozens for manage-topics.sh) to be updated in this phase. This keeps all existing call sites working unchanged while enabling proper attribution for any caller that opts in. commands/task.md's Sync Mode caller of reconcile-artifacts.sh was updated to pass its sync_session_id (moved earlier) for genuine attribution.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added self-generating --session-id fallback instead of touching every caller)*

scope_hypothesis_confirmed.asserted: exactly four specs/state.json write sites across three scripts
scope_hypothesis_confirmed.measured: confirmed exactly four; additionally discovered archive-task.sh has zero callers anywhere in the source store
